exposure: Chewing sugar-free gum after cesarean delivery
outcome: Time to first passage of stool
Time to first passage of flatus
Time to first audible intestinal sounds
cohort: 372 women aged 20-35 years scheduled for planned cesarean delivery at Armed Forces Hospital Southern Region, Khamis Mushayt, Saudi Arabia
finding: Chewing gum after cesarean delivery significantly improved intestinal recovery, shortened hospital stay and parenteral therapy duration, and reduced postoperative complications compared to oral fluids or no intervention.
